page_kind: two-column prose with numbers and units
instructions: Fill this from the page IMAGE, never from the PDF's own OCR layer or from any OCR output without checking every character.
blocks: one entry per block in reading order; type is one of heading, text, list_item, caption, table, figure, footnote, header, footer.
text: exactly as printed (keep hyphens, units, commas inside numbers); write [illegible] for anything you cannot read.
tables: every cell, row by row; use {"text": ..., "colspan": n} for merged cells.
numbers: every number on the page as printed, with a few words of context; set verified=true only after checking it on the image.
When done set status to 'verified', verified_by to your name and verified_on to the date. Silent errors are measured against this file, so an unchecked number here hides a real error.
